title: A fold for spring
alt: A pale-blue origami crane rests on a textured presentation box with a red silk ribbon.
description: An intricate folded-paper form with connected wings and carefully rendered paper, fabric and embossed packaging.
prompt: A striking luxury editorial still life of an intricate pale-blue origami crane resting on an open ivory presentation box. The crane has one coherent head and long beak, one folded neck, a pair of sharply pleated wings and one tapered tail, all formed from one continuous sheet of paper. The box lining carries subtle embossed wave patterns that catch the light without any lettering. A narrow red silk ribbon winds naturally around one corner of the box and lies on the warm gray table. Beautiful paper fibers, crisp fold geometry, precise contact shadows and restrained modern Japanese design, no words or diagrams.
